title: Let mercy stop the wavering
summary: The merciful Creator sustains what He has made, so the heart can stop wavering. Return the heart to shelter before it hardens again.
takeaway: Return the heart to shelter before it hardens again.
lifeApplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.

source.shortMeaning: The merciful Creator sustains what He has made, so the heart can stop wavering.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind sways, remember the One who created you still carries you.
